tool_arguments.summary:
Gross margin comparison (most recent comparable quarters):

- NVIDIA Q2 fiscal 2027 (ended July 26, 2026): 75.0% GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin. (S1.1)
- AMD Q2 fiscal 2027 (ended June 27, 2026): 54% GAAP gross margin, 56% non-GAAP gross margin. (S2.1)

Drivers of the gap: NVIDIA's data-center–centric architecture and higher‑margin AI accelerator sales produce a gross margin roughly 20 percentage points above AMD's. AMD's broader client‑CPU and mixed‑product mix, plus lower‑margin custom engagements, pulls its gross margin down. The non‑GAAP adjustments for both firms mainly reflect stock‑based compensation and acquisition‑related items, but the underlying GAAP gap remains large.

Sources: S1.1, S2.1
